title: Remove the false 'Bundled JSON removed' skip on ContentRepositoryImpl's acceptance suite in content_repository_test.dart
rule: TQ-7 (honest skip/weaken reason) / TQ-8 (bug fix needs a real regression test)

evidence.quote: skip: 'Bundled JSON removed — content now fetched from cloud storage',
skip: 'Bundled JSON removed — content now fetched from cloud storage',
/// Retained for potential future use (content updates, text downloads).

why: I removed both `skip:` parameters and ran `flutter test` against the real bundled assets: 8 of 9 tests in the first group passed immediately, proving bundled JSON was never removed — 16 curricula still ship under assets/content/hierarchy/*.json (declared in pubspec.yaml:202), and ContentRepositoryImpl (the asset-JSON reader) is the live implementation behind contentRepositoryProvider; CloudContentService is explicitly commented 'Retained for potential future use', i.e. not wired into content loading at all. The 9th test — searching 'Berakhot' — failed with an empty result: ContentRepositoryImpl.search() indexes CurriculumLabelRenderer's Ashkenazi-transliterated leaf names ('Berakhos'), not the raw displayNameEn ('Berakhot') the real asset data and the test both use, so a user who types the un-transliterated spelling gets zero search results. Instead of fixing the index or correcting the query, someone silenced the entire 11-test suite (both the acceptance and performance groups) with an unrelated, false excuse — leaving the real-asset load/parse/config/filter path for all 16 curricula (the mechanism every content-browsing screen ultimately depends on) without automated regression coverage, and hiding a real search-matching gap behind a skip reason that reads as 'not applicable' rather than 'known failure'.
recommendation: Remove both `skip:` parameters. Either fix ContentRepositoryImpl.search to also match the raw/un-rendered displayNameEn (so both transliteration spellings resolve), or, if only the rendered form should ever be searchable, change the test's query to the Ashkenazi-rendered spelling with a one-line comment explaining why the raw spelling intentionally doesn't match. Re-run the full file to confirm all 11 tests pass against real assets.
acceptance_criteria: `flutter test test/features/content_browsing/data/repositories/content_repository_test.dart` passes end-to-end with no `skip:` on either group.
The 'search returns items matching Hebrew or English query' test passes against real bundled assets (index fixed, or query corrected with a stated reason).

corrections: Minor: finding says '16 curricula' ship as bundled assets; assets/content/hierarchy/ contains 15 JSON files (CurriculumId enum has 9 values, some composited). Doesn't affect the core claim.
